Internal: jdeclare_missing() on text variables

Source: R/recode.R
dot-jst_jdeclare_missing_text.Rd

The route a call naming text variables takes (Slate E5; rulings R26 and R27; see the banner above). Called by jdeclare_missing() once the data frame and the variables are resolved, with the call's arguments as given; returns the data frame. Every line it offers names the data frame and the text variables, keeps codes and labels as typed (numbers quoted), and leaves out what a text variable cannot take (convention = "stata" or "sas", range), so a line never stops on a second problem (ruling R23).

Usage

.jst_jdeclare_missing_text(
  data,
  data_name,
  data_kind,
  data_sub_expr,
  arg1,
  target_vars,
  codes,
  labels,
  range,
  convention,
  missing.notice,
  modify,
  cl,
  mc,
  vars,
  vars_sub_expr,
  envir,
  bare = NULL
)
